# crypto_service.rb - Cryptographic service with circuit breaker pattern
require 'openssl'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'

module CryptoLib
  class CircuitBreaker
    STATES = [:closed, :open, :half_open].freeze
    
    attr_reader :state, :failure_count, :options
    
    def initialize(opts = {})
      @state = :closed
      @failure_count = 0
      @options = default_options.deep_merge(opts)
      @last_failure_time = nil
      @mutex = Mutex.new
    end
    
    def call(&block)
      case @state
      when :closed
        execute_with_tracking(&block)
      when :open
        check_timeout_or_raise
      when :half_open
        execute_half_open(&block)
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def default_options
      { threshold: 5, timeout: 30, cipher: { algorithm: 'aes-256-gcm', key_derivation: 'pbkdf2' } }
    end
    
    def execute_with_tracking(&block)
      result = block.call(@options[:cipher])
      reset_failures
      result
    rescue => e
      record_failure(e)
      raise
    end
    
    def execute_half_open(&block)
      result = block.call(@options[:cipher])
      transition_to(:closed)
      reset_failures
      result
    rescue => e
      transition_to(:open)
      raise
    end
    
    def check_timeout_or_raise
      if Time.now - @last_failure_time >= @options[:timeout]
        transition_to(:half_open)
        call { |cipher_opts| yield cipher_opts }
      else
        raise CircuitOpenError, "Circuit is open, retry after timeout"
      end
    end
    
    def record_failure(error)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @failure_count += 1
        @last_failure_time = Time.now
        if @failure_count >= @options[:threshold]
          transition_to(:open)
        end
      end
    end
    
    def reset_failures
      @mutex.synchronize { @failure_count = 0 }
    end
    
    def transition_to(new_state)
      @state = new_state
    end
  end
  
  class CircuitOpenError < StandardError; end
  
  class EncryptionService
    def initialize(config = {})
      @breaker = CircuitBreaker.new(config)
      @key_cache = {}
    end
    
    def encrypt(plaintext, user_params = {})
      @breaker.call do |cipher_opts|
        merged = cipher_opts.deep_merge(user_params)
        perform_encryption(plaintext, merged)
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def perform_encryption(plaintext, opts)
      algorithm = opts[:algorithm] || 'aes-256-gcm'
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(algorithm)
      cipher.encrypt
      
      key = derive_key(opts)
      cipher.key = key
      iv = cipher.random_iv
      
      if cipher.authenticated?
        cipher.auth_data = opts[:auth_data] || ''
      end
      
      encrypted = cipher.update(plaintext) + cipher.final
      tag = cipher.authenticated? ? cipher.auth_tag : nil
      
      { ciphertext: encrypted, iv: iv, tag: tag, algorithm: algorithm }
    end
    
    def derive_key(opts)
      kd_method = opts[:key_derivation] || 'pbkdf2'
      case kd_method
      when 'pbkdf2'
        salt = opts[:salt] || SecureRandom.random_bytes(16)
        iterations = opts[:iterations] || 100_000
        OpenSSL::PKCS5.pbkdf2_hmac(
          opts[:password] || SecureRandom.hex(32),
          salt, iterations, 32, OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new
        )
      when 'raw'
        opts[:raw_key]
      end
    end
  end
end

# Hash extension used by the library
class Hash
  def deep_merge(other_hash)
    return self unless other_hash.is_a?(Hash)
    merger = proc { |_key, v1, v2|
      if v1.is_a?(Hash) && v2.is_a?(Hash)
        v1.merge(v2, &merger)
      else
        v2
      end
    }
    merge(other_hash, &merger)
  end
end
